label: training-USGS-wide-train-dev-blind-source-v2
selection: GroupID=SHA(canonical sorted eventIDs); stratum=min lexicographic coarse cell among group members. Sort strata; within stratum sort SHA(seed+groupID),groupID. Assign each whole group to the split minimizing (groups already assigned in this stratum, total groups already assigned, SHA(seed|stratum|groupID|split), split), over train/dev/blind. Then each split uses group-hash order and roundrobin nonoverlapping time/ID sorted <=5event windows, exactly10charts50QA and >=3groups each; insufficient STOP, no swaps/backfill/threshold changes.
leakage_limit: New V2 strong-component exclusion uses shared event alias OR both <=72h and <=500km association, with transitive closure and no strong-component overlap across train/dev/blind or retained old250 anchors. Coarse30lat60lon only stratifies/reports geography; geographic overlap is allowed and geographic OOD is not required. Original2724 coarse-inclusive closure remains historical evidence for old results only. Incomplete aliases/catalogs and other correlations remain limitations; no absolute absence-of-leakage claim.
strong_closure_policy: Strong edges: shared event alias OR both delta_time<=72h and great-circle distance<=500km. All historical250 events remain exclusion anchors. Preserve original2724 history edges by identity; use only their alias/near72h500km subset as old-old strong edges. Coarse30lat60lon is stratification/statistics only; geographic overlap allowed, not geographic OOD. New strong components never split.
additional_train_policy: Unselected groups/windows may be declared candidates only; no extra rendering/QA/training in this invocation
